playerMetadata.pitch: Two blood-drained bodies revive the legend of Brannam's dead vampire tyrant. Investigate a dying city where the obvious monster may not be the killer, and where solving the murders may still leave something far older beneath your feet.
playerMetadata.setting: Brannam, a decaying former trade city on the Aulach River

hard.rule: Victor Marlowe committed the initial murders of Marya Dolen and Harrin Velth; Edric did not.
Edric begins dormant in the Sealed Crypt unless campaign state explicitly says otherwise.
Evelyn Marlowe died before the campaign and Victor exhumed her body for his hidden laboratory.
The Flooded Shrine is an ancient alien biological device associated with the King Below and is the deeper corrupting influence.
Stopping Victor or Edric does not automatically restore Brannam.
Restoring Brannam through the Sacrificial Blood Rite carries recurring annual human sacrifice and alien-mark consequences.

conditional.rule: Breaching the Sealed Crypt wakes Edric in a weakened state.
If awakened and not immediately destroyed/contained, Edric seeks refuge in Saint Arlen's Catacombs and begins feeding.
Destroying the Flooded Shrine ends its local influence but leaves Brannam materially decayed.

soft.rule: Minor residents, ordinary shops and street-level details may be improvised consistently within the established district character.

freeImprovisation.rule: Exact dialogue, weather, food, minor possessions and non-plot ordinary residents may be improvised so long as knowledge boundaries and campaign state remain intact.

adaptationNotes: No campaign-specific community actual-play evidence was verified in the current research pass.
Use redundant clue paths because the source is an open investigation, but do not add omniscient exposition.
Run murders, collapse and Edric restoration as independent clocks/state, not scripted chapters.
Suggested choices are contextual affordances only; player free text remains authoritative input.
Do not force Edric to awaken if Victor is stopped early.
